# Resource: tfe_workspace_variable_set

Adds and removes a workspace from a variable set's scope.

~> **Note:** `TfeVariableSet` has a deprecated argument `WorkspaceIds` that should not be used alongside this resource. They manage the same attachments and are mutually exclusive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic usage

resource "tfe_variable_set" "example" {
  name         = "my-variable-set"
  description  = "Example fixture variable set."
  organization = tfe_organization.example.name
}

resource "tfe_workspace_variable_set" "test" {
  variable_set_id = tfe_variable_set.example.id
  workspace_id    = tfe_workspace.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `VariableSetId` (String) The variable set ID.
- `WorkspaceId` (String) Workspace ID to add the variable set to.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of the variable set attachment. ID format: `<workspace-id>_<variable-set-id>`.



## Import

Resource tfe_workspace_variable_set can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <ORGANIZATION>/<WORKSPACE NAME>/<VARIABLE SET NAME>
terraform import tfe_workspace_variable_set.test 'my-org-name/workspace/My Variable Set'
```
